items.text: In high-income health systems, what is the budget impact for the payer of extending community pharmacy opening into weekday evenings and Sundays, including avoided out-of-hours GP contacts, emergency department attendances and emergency supplies, over up to three years?
items.population: Populations served by community pharmacies with extended opening
items.intervention: Extended weekday evening or Sunday opening of community pharmacies
items.outcome: Net budget impact for the payer, re-expressed in 2026 prices

items.text: What do pharmacists, owners, commissioners, other clinicians and members of the public report about who uses extended pharmacy hours, staffing and safety, and whether demand moves between services?
items.population: Pharmacists, pharmacy owners, commissioners, clinicians and members of the public with experience of extended hours
items.outcome: Views and experiences of use, access, staffing, safety and displacement

finer: Feasible for one analyst in six months with structured extraction; interesting to the board; novel in keeping budget and practice evidence separate; ethical as a review of published and grey literature; relevant to a funding decision in March 2027.
summary: One PICO question for the budget strand and one SPIDER question for the practice-and-views strand.
